XFOR.name: X4 Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
XFOR.moa: Oral CXCR4 antagonist → releases neutrophils from marrow → raises ANC
XFOR.efficacy: Approved for WHIM but sales tiny (~$2.5M/qtr, deprioritized). Value bet = 4WARD Ph3 in chronic neutropenia (co-primary: infection rate + ANC); enrollment completing Q3 2026, topline H2 2027.
XFOR.diff_detail: Moderate — oral once-daily vs. injectable G-CSF (current CN SoC) offers QoL advantage; CXCR4 mechanism may be more targeted in specific CN subtypes; however G-CSF is cheap, effective, and deeply entrenched.
XFOR.catalyst: 4WARD Ph3 topline (chronic neutropenia); enrollment done Q3'26

PRLD.name: Prelude Therapeutics Incorporated
PRLD.drug: PRT12396 — mutant-selective JAK2 V617F inhibitor (+ KAT6A/SMARCA2 degraders)
PRLD.moa: PRT12396 = mutant-selective JAK2 V617F inhibitor; PRT13722 = KAT6A-selective degrader; PRT7732 = oral SMARCA2 degrader (SMARCA4-mut cancers)
PRLD.efficacy: PRT12396 Ph1 just initiating — no human data. Preclinical: selective JAK2 V617F inhibition (spares wild-type). PRT13722 (KAT6A degrader) preclinical: picomolar degradation + durable CRs in breast PDX.
PRLD.diff_detail: High -- PRT12396 is a mutant-selective JAK2 V617F inhibitor aiming for disease modification vs non-selective ruxolitinib; PRT13722 shows deeper regressions than Pfizer's prifetrastat in head-to-head preclinical models
PRLD.catalyst: PRT12396 (mutant-JAK2) Ph1 first data in PV

GERN.name: Geron Corporation
GERN.moa: First-in-class telomerase inhibitor; targets telomerase RNA template to suppress malignant clone proliferation
GERN.efficacy: Approved LR-MDS (IMerge: RBC-TI ~40%); real-world ~37.5% TI. Myelofibrosis: IMpactMF Ph3 testing OS — the expansion swing.
GERN.diff_detail: High -- only approved telomerase inhibitor; IMpactMF only Ph3 in MF with OS as primary endpoint (disease-modifying vs symptom palliation)
GERN.catalyst: IMpactMF myelofibrosis OS data + EU launch

SGP.name: SpyGlass Pharma, Inc.
SGP.drug: BIM-IOL System — bimatoprost drug-pads on an intraocular lens
SGP.moa: IOL-mounted sustained bimatoprost pad; FP agonist
SGP.efficacy: FIH (n=24, 3yr): 37% IOP reduction, sustained, drop-free — implanted at ROUTINE cataract surgery (no separate procedure). Registrational Ph3 ahead.
SGP.diff_detail: High — durable 3yr IOP reduction bundled into cataract surgery; near-complete drop independence vs iDose TR/Durysta

PALI.name: Palisade Bio, Inc.
PALI.moa: Oral colon-targeted PDE4 inhibitor prodrug; locally bioactivated anti-inflammatory
PALI.efficacy: Ph1b (n=5, open-label): 100% clinical response, 40% remission by Day 7 (mean Mayo −63%) — tiny, uncontrolled. ASCENTRA-UC Ph2 ahead.
PALI.diff_detail: Moderate — GI-restricted PDE4 inhibition avoids systemic apremilast AEs; Ph1b (n=5) 100% clinical response, 40% remission Day 7; IND cleared for randomized Ph2

SABS.name: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc.
SABS.moa: Fully human anti-thymocyte globulin; depletes pathologic T cells
SABS.efficacy: Human Ph1 (n=4 vs 1 pbo): C-peptide preserved/rising vs placebo decline; TIR 73%→85% by Day 120 — a low-immunogenicity human ATG (redosable, unlike rabbit ATG). SAFEGUARD Ph2b ahead.
SABS.diff_detail: Moderate — fully human DiversitAb polyclonal platform; Ph1 (n=4 vs 1 pbo) TIR 73%→85% by Day 120, C-peptide preserved; no serum sickness/ADAs (n=68 total); differentiates from murine ATG

CABA.name: Cabaletta Bio, Inc.
CABA.efficacy: Single-infusion CD19 CAR-T: RESET-Myositis showed drug-free improvement in refractory patients (immune reset). Registrational myositis cohort enrolling → BLA.
CABA.diff_detail: High — 86% Ph1/2 DM patients met registrational TIS endpoint off immunomodulators, durable to 1.5yr; myositis (not gMG) is now lead registrational program.

AVTX.name: Avalo Therapeutics, Inc.
AVTX.efficacy: LOTUS Ph2 (HS, n=253): MET primary at both doses (HiSCR75 + HiSCR50). Anti-IL-1β (not IL-36) — a niche for IL-17-refractory HS. Ph3 ahead.
AVTX.diff_detail: Moderate — anti-IL-1β mAb; LOTUS Ph2 (n=253) HiSCR75 42.2/42.9% vs 25.6% pbo (p=0.004 combined), highest absolute response for a study this size; no neutropenia/infection signal; below bimekizumab's ~49-50% rate.

ENTX.name: Entera Bio Ltd.
ENTX.moa: oral PTH(1-34) peptide tablet via N-Tab platform
ENTX.efficacy: Ph2 (n=161): 2.5mg dose gave +2.7% lumbar-spine, +1.8% total-hip, +2.8% femoral-neck BMD at 6mo (p<0.0001/≤0.02) — an ORAL bone-builder (vs daily Forteo injections). BVF-funded Ph3 through NDA. $4M cash (funded via the PIPE).
ENTX.diff_detail: Moderate — oral PTH avoids daily injection burden of Forteo; Phase 2 BMD gains directionally support anabolic effect but Ph3 (n=750) unfunded beyond prep stage.

IVA.name: Inventiva S.A.
IVA.moa: Pan-PPAR agonist (α/δ/γ) reducing hepatic inflammation, fat, fibrosis
IVA.efficacy: NATIVE-2 Ph2b: MASH resolution 53% vs 22% placebo; fibrosis improvement 48% vs 23% — strong dual benefit. NATiV3 Ph3 topline is the make-or-break (funded through it).
IVA.diff_detail: Moderate — Ph2b dual-endpoint proof of concept solid but Ph3 NATiV3 topline timeline (company Q4'26 guide vs CT.gov Sept'27 primary completion) creates execution risk ahead of binary readout.

ALLO.name: Allogene Therapeutics, Inc.
ALLO.moa: Allogeneic CD19-directed CAR T cell (TALEN-edited, off-the-shelf); single 120M-cell infusion with abbreviated LD conditioning; eliminates residual CD19+ tumor cells in patients with ctDNA-detectable MRD after 1L R-CHOP
ALLO.efficacy: ALPHA3 interim (n=24): MRD clearance 58% vs 17% (observation), ctDNA −98%; standout safety (no CRS/ICANS). The registrational metric — event-free survival — reads out 2027.
ALLO.diff_detail: Moderate — cema-cel's allogeneic, outpatient, off-the-shelf format in 1L MRD+ consolidation is novel vs no approved CAR T in this setting, but faces the fundamental uncertainty of whether MRD clearance translates to EFS benefit that the autologous paradigm (liso-cel, axi-cel in 2L) has already established in higher-risk patients.

CCCC.name: C4 Therapeutics, Inc.
CCCC.moa: Oral IKZF1/3 MonoDAC degrader (molecular glue); degrades Ikaros/Aiolos transcription factors in myeloma cells + activates T cells
CCCC.efficacy: Ph1 (median 7 priors): 53% ORR at RP2D (incl. CRs, MRD-neg), durable. + elranatamab combo + MOMENTUM Ph2 (4L+); Pfizer-backed earlier-line push.
CCCC.diff_detail: High — potential best-in-class oral degrader; combinable with BCMA bispecifics (elranatamab) for earlier lines.
CCCC.catalyst: Cemsidomide + elranatamab combo update; MOMENTUM 4L+ ORR

IMMX.name: Immix Biopharma, Inc.
IMMX.moa: BCMA-targeted CAR-T with sterically optimized digital filter reducing non-specific activation
IMMX.efficacy: NEXICART-2 (US Ph2, R/R AL amyloidosis): 95% CR (19/20), all within 1yr, no relapses, MRD-negative; only low-grade CRS. BLA-track.
IMMX.diff_detail: High — first-in-class CAR-T in a disease with no approved drugs and <10% CR on current therapy; clean CAR-T safety (low-grade CRS, no neurotox).

SLN.name: Silence Therapeutics plc
SLN.moa: GalNAc-siRNA silencing TMPRSS6 in hepatocytes; increases hepcidin expression; restricts iron to bone marrow; reduces erythrocytosis
SLN.efficacy: SANRECO Ph2 (Aug'26) POSITIVE: 88% clinical response vs 19% placebo (placebo-adjusted +69%); most patients phlebotomy-free through Q12W dosing. Ph3 planned 1H'27.
SLN.diff_detail: High -- durable, infrequent SC dosing (Q6-12W) siRNA cutting phlebotomy burden; only 5 phlebotomies on-treatment vs 80 pre-treatment across 21 pts, an efficacy signal rivaling near-approval rusfertide

TNGX.name: Tango Therapeutics, Inc.
TNGX.moa: MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor; exploits MTA accumulation in MTAP-deleted tumors; selectively inhibits PRMT5 in MTAP-del cancer cells with metabolic synthetic lethality
TNGX.efficacy: 2L MTAP-del PDAC monotherapy: 25% ORR, 7.2mo PFS (~2× historical); 49% ORR late-line histology-agnostic; clean safety. RevMed combo (+daraxonrasib) for 1L.
TNGX.diff_detail: High — 92% ORR + 90% 6mo-PFS in MTAP-del RAS-mut 2/3L PDAC w/ daraxonrasib combo; first PRMT5+RAS(ON) chemo-free combo data in PDAC
TNGX.catalyst: Ph3 1L PDAC design; lung monotherapy data

AGEN.name: Agenus Inc.
AGEN.moa: Fc-enhanced anti-CTLA-4 (BOT; enhanced ADCC) + anti-PD-1 (BAL); dual checkpoint blockade with Treg depletion and NK/macrophage engagement
AGEN.efficacy: Neoadjuvant MSS colon (NEST/UNICORN): ~30% pathologic complete response, 35-40% major pathologic response, no recurrences yet. ROBBIN Ph3 running (funded to 2031).
AGEN.diff_detail: High — first Fc-enhanced CTLA-4/PD-1 combo w/ ~30% pCR in neoadjuvant MSS colon Ph2 (NEST/UNICORN, n=38); no approved IO regimen in MSS colon adjuvant/neoadjuvant setting

RLMD.name: Relmada Therapeutics, Inc.
RLMD.moa: Sustained-release intravesical gemcitabine + docetaxel combo (dual-drug polymer depot); not a viral construct despite name; local high-dose chemo release
RLMD.efficacy: Early (n~21): CR 95% any-time, 76-80% at 12mo (BCG-unresponsive subset 80% at 12mo); zero Grade 3+. Unusually durable for the stage.
RLMD.diff_detail: High — 95% any-time CRR class-leading at AUA26 but n=21; durability (76% at 12mo) not yet confirmed in randomized Ph3

OLMA.name: Olema Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
OLMA.moa: CERAN (Complete Estrogen Receptor ANtagonist): combined ER antagonism + degradation (SERD + SERM properties); oral; no partial agonism
OLMA.efficacy: OPERA-01 Ph3 topline due Fall 2026. Ph1/2: mono mPFS 4.8mo (ESR1-mut 5.6mo); +ribociclib combo mPFS 15.5mo. Make-or-break pivotal.
OLMA.diff_detail: Moderate — CERAN mechanism vs PROTAC (vepdegestrant, now approved) vs fulvestrant; mPFS 4.8mo mono in heavily pretreated vs elacestrant EMERALD 3.8mo ESR1-mut; combo data (mPFS 15.5mo) far stronger but OPERA-02 readout is 2027+.

FTH.name: Faeth Therapeutics, Inc.
FTH.moa: Combo PI3K-alpha + dual mTORC1/2 pathway inhibition
FTH.efficacy: Ph1b (n=15, post-taxane): 47% ORR (small). Ph2 endometrial topline due year-end 2026 — make-or-break.
FTH.diff_detail: Moderate — multi-node PI3K/AKT/mTOR combo differentiated from single-node inhibitors, but class has history of tolerability-limited efficacy in endometrial cancer

ANL.name: Adlai Nortye Ltd.
ANL.moa: Oral pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor — small molecule targeting RAS in active (GTP-bound ON) state across multiple KRAS/NRAS/HRAS mutations
ANL.efficacy: No clinical data; preclinical activity in RAS-mut PDAC/NSCLC/CRC comparable to pan-RAS(ON) benchmarks. Ph1 dose-escalation ongoing.
ANL.diff_detail: Moderate — pan-RAS(ON) design covers broad mutation spectrum with preclinical potency in PDAC/NSCLC/CRC models, but this is preclinical-to-early-clinical translation with zero human efficacy data yet, competing against more advanced RMC-9805/ERAS-0015

HUMA.name: Humacyte, Inc.
HUMA.drug: ATEV — acellular tissue-engineered vessel (bioengineered blood vessel)
HUMA.moa: Off-the-shelf acellular human extracellular matrix vascular conduit for arterial reconstruction
HUMA.efficacy: THREE positive Ph3s. V012 (women): ATEV SUPERIOR to AV fistula (220 vs 129 catheter-free days). sBLA filing. Also vascular trauma (approved).
HUMA.diff_detail: High — first off-the-shelf bioengineered vascular graft; trauma approved; V012 Ph3 interim decisively beat AV fistula on catheter-free days (p=0.0007) and infection rate, expanding TAM ~10× into ~500K US HD-access patients.

OCS.name: Oculis Holding AG
OCS.moa: Privosegtor: platform for acute/non-arteritic optic neuropathy (AON/NAION), BTD+PRIME. Licaminlimab: anti-TNF-α biologic for dry eye disease (DED), genotype-based precision medicine.
OCS.efficacy: DME eye-drop (OCS-01) FAILED Ph3; re-based on privosegtor: ACUITY Ph2 (acute optic neuritis) met safety + neuroprotection signals (GCIPL preservation). PIONEER Ph3.
OCS.diff_detail: High — privosegtor has Breakthrough Therapy + PRIME designation in NAION, an acute optic neuropathy with zero approved therapies and >60% permanent visual impairment; licaminlimab adds genotype-based DED precision medicine as second pillar.

CUE.name: Cue Biopharma, Inc.
CUE.moa: Dual-mechanism anti-IgE mAb (in-licensed Apr 2026, ex-Greater China)
CUE.efficacy: CUE-221 (licensed from Ascendant Apr 2026): Ph1 rapid + durable free-IgE suppression — a longer-acting take on the validated Xolair mechanism. CSU Ph2 (China) 2H 2026; food allergy global.
CUE.diff_detail: Moderate — newly in-licensed CUE-221 anti-IgE now company's stated lead asset; ongoing China Ph2 CSU trial, topline end Q3 2026; no efficacy data yet disclosed; displaces CUE-401/CUE-101 as primary driver.

IPSC.name: Century Therapeutics, Inc.
IPSC.moa: Allo-Evasion 5.0 iPSC-derived beta islet therapy for T1D
IPSC.efficacy: Preclinical: durable normoglycemia >8 months in animal models; GMP cell bank ready. NO human data. IND Q4 2026.
IPSC.diff_detail: Not — 5th-gen Allo-Evasion platform; durable normoglycemia >8 months in animal models (updated from >6mo); no human data; still behind Vertex/Sana on clinical timeline

VTVT.name: vTv Therapeutics Inc.
VTVT.moa: Oral liver-selective glucokinase activator; hepatic glucose uptake stimulation
VTVT.efficacy: Cadisegliatin (TTP399) — first-in-class ORAL adjunct to insulin in T1D: Ph2 SimpliciT1 cut severe/symptomatic hypoglycemia + improved HbA1c with no DKA/hypoglycemia risk. CATT1 Ph3 topline IMMINENT.
VTVT.diff_detail: High — first liver-selective GKA with Breakthrough Therapy Designation; Ph2 showed ~50% fewer hypoglycemic episodes; HbA1c -0.3%; no DKA in Ph2 — unique T1D adjunct

ACET.name: Adicet Bio, Inc.
ACET.moa: Allogeneic gamma delta CAR T cell targeting CD20; off-the-shelf B-cell depleting cell therapy with potentially superior tissue trafficking
ACET.efficacy: Autoimmune (LN + SLE, n=22): deep B-cell depletion + drug-free responses on early patients (≥12-mo follow-up) — the first off-the-shelf CAR-T signal in lupus. Trades below cash.
ACET.diff_detail: High — 100% renal response in n=7 early LN/SLE patients (5 LN, 2 SLE); 3 complete renal responses; no SAEs; only 2 grade 1 CRS; γδ T cell tissue-trafficking thesis intact pending expanded n≥20 data

QTTB.name: Q32 Bio Inc.
QTTB.efficacy: SIGNAL-AA Part B: 35% mean SALT reduction, 40% SALT-20 (mITT) at wk36 — regrowth continuing (wk52 data ahead). Anti-IL-7Rα (T-cell reset) for AA.
QTTB.diff_detail: High — SIGNAL-AA Part B (July 13 2026, n=33): 35.3% mean SALT reduction, 40.0% SALT-20 response (mITT) at wk36, exceeding analyst expectations of 15-30%.

PROK.name: ProKidney Corp.
PROK.drug: Rilparencel (REACT) — autologous renal cell therapy (injected into kidney)
PROK.moa: autologous kidney-derived cell therapy (patented cell therapy; proprietary regenerative medicine approach)
PROK.efficacy: REGEN-007 Ph2 (bilateral, n=24): 78% improvement in eGFR slope (p<0.001) — a patient's own kidney cells re-injected to slow decline. FDA-aligned on eGFR slope for ACCELERATED APPROVAL. PROACT-1 Ph3.
PROK.diff_detail: High — FDA-confirmed accelerated-approval surrogate (eGFR slope ≥1.5 mL/min/1.73m²/yr vs sham); PROACT 1 enrollment on track mid-2026.

BMEA.name: Biomea Fusion, Inc.
BMEA.drug: Icovamenib — oral covalent menin inhibitor (beta-cell regenerator)
BMEA.moa: Covalent menin inhibitor; beta-cell regeneration MOA
BMEA.efficacy: COVALENT-211/212 (insulin-deficient T2D + T2D-on-GLP-1, ~60 pts each): 26-wk HbA1c readout Q4 2026 — no efficacy yet. Novel thesis: menin inhibition regenerates insulin-producing beta cells (disease-modifying, not just glucose-lowering).
BMEA.diff_detail: High — first-in-class oral menin inhibitor restoring beta-cell function with durable effect after short dosing course; going-concern doubt is a financing, not efficacy, risk.

CING.name: Cingulate Inc.
CING.moa: once-daily oral multi-core extended-release dexmethylphenidate (PTR platform); dopamine/norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor
CING.efficacy: Ph3 met ADHD-RS-5/CGI-S endpoints (a once-daily stimulant with precise onset-to-evening coverage), BUT got a CRL (Jun 2026) on CMC (manufacturing) — resubmitting. Efficacy clean; the issue is manufacturing.
CING.diff_detail: Moderate — differentiated PTR delivery platform, but CRL confirms CMC-only deficiency, not efficacy
